_about: Short plain-language descriptions for the Madden 27 persona DNA traits shown in the player profile. Written from the trait names, not copied from the game; blanks are allowed and the card then shows the name alone.

descriptions.TeamFirst: Puts the team ahead of personal numbers.
descriptions.Diva: Wants the spotlight and the ball.
descriptions.Approachable: Easy for teammates and staff to talk to.
descriptions.Assertive: Says what he wants and goes after it.
descriptions.Cerebral: Thinks the game as much as he plays it.
descriptions.Composed: Same pulse in the fourth quarter as the first.
descriptions.Contractminded: Keeps one eye on the next deal.
descriptions.Demanding: Expects a lot from everyone around him.
descriptions.Empathetic: Reads the room and the locker room.
descriptions.Headstrong: Hard to talk out of anything.
descriptions.Loyal: Sticks with his team and people.
descriptions.Opportunistic: Takes the opening when it shows.
descriptions.Principled: Has lines he will not cross.
descriptions.Private: Keeps life off the field to himself.
descriptions.Selfless: Happy to do the unglamorous work.
descriptions.Transparent: What you see is what you get.
